pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to losing positions or placing secondary entries within 50 pips of an existing open order in the same direction; pyramiding is limited exclusively to trades showing a minimum of +$10.00 floating profit.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: No order execution is authorized unless the multi-timeframe ATR expansion ratio is below the 90th percentile, and order flow imbalance confirms zero high-impact liquidity sweeps on the 5-minute candle close.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate automated trailing stops once floating profit hits +$12.00, securing minimum wins at +$15.00 and allowing runners to target the +$30.00 structural boundary.
